item.text:
REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: The authority, provenance, RCA, review, and refactor rules are sound, but the token-budget checkpoint is not enforceable. The profile declares 500k as a warning/reflection threshold, while the execution-receipt schema records no checkpoint status or reflection reference. Thus an over-threshold attempt can be accepted without the required control.
FINDING: high|docs/factory-ng/schemas/factory.execution-receipt-v1.schema.json|Accepted receipts exceeding 500k effective tokens need not record a warning/reflection checkpoint|This makes the required 500k control advisory prose rather than a validated contract
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Add schema fields and conditional validation requiring a non-cancelling warning/reflection checkpoint when computed effective tokens exceed 500k, define the computation, and add valid/invalid over-threshold fixtures.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: An otherwise valid accepted receipt reports input_tokens 510001 and all other token counters zero, passing gates with no checkpoint or reflection record; it validates unchanged.
